reason: The lab report and the no-oxide dose are what I look for, but $29.99 a month for one supplement is a lot on my budget, and I can get magnesium at the drugstore for much less. I also forget my vitamins half the time, so I'd probably leave half the box in a drawer.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is more packaging waste, and I'm paying extra for that packaging when I could buy a bottle for a lot less.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 to $18 a month, or a small trial box so I can see if I actually remember to take it.
